prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1020; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the adjuster following up on your claim. This call is being recorded. Do you consent to the recording?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Please state where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving in Conroe, Texas, in the right lane of the main road, heading toward the shopping center.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was changing lanes to move over to the left lane because the right lane was ending. I checked my mirror, saw the car behind me was far back, and started to move over.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?

A: I did. I had it on for a few seconds before I started moving.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle came up quickly in the lane I was moving into and clipped the rear passenger side of my car. My car spun a little and hit the curb on the shoulder.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?

A: Not clearly. I heard a horn and then felt the impact. I don't think I could have seen it sooner.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: I have a bad headache, I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and bright lights bother my eyes. My doctor said I have a concussion and I need to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and I have a follow-up scheduled with my primary doctor.

Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was careful during the lane change and I want this claim handled as soon as possible because I'm missing work.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
